entities.summary: Eden Giselle Silva is a British tennis player of Russian and Sri Lankan descent who specializes in doubles. She has career-high WTA rankings of No. 112 in doubles, reached on 21 October 2024, and No. 298 in singles, achieved on 3 April 2023.
